subject.title: [Bug]: 2026.6.x regression cascade — memory search broken, then sessions lost on every reconnect (multi-agent deployment broken)

question: Should maintainers keep this umbrella open as the canonical production-regression tracker, or split the remaining crash/config, memory-provider, and session-recovery pieces now that two partial fixes have landed?
rationale: Current main has credible partial fixes, but the remaining scope mixes live reproduction, product recovery UX, and a proposed config surface that automation should not decide.

options.title: Keep canonical umbrella open
options.body: Use this issue to collect live repro evidence and route narrower follow-up fixes until the production cascade is verified fixed end to end.

options.title: Split remaining work
options.body: Create separate issues for the config crash path, remaining memory provider behavior, and archived-session recovery UX, then close this only after the split is linked.

options.title: Close after current-main proof
options.body: Close this only if a maintainer or reporter confirms current main resolves the deployed memory and reconnect failure without new logs.

recommendation.title: Keep canonical umbrella open
recommendation.body: Use this issue to collect live repro evidence and route narrower follow-up fixes until the production cascade is verified fixed end to end.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the most relevant current reconnect-session fix and the closed server-side adoption attempt tied directly to this issue.
